reviews.title: Only one list at a time
reviews.text: How is this rated so highly? I need multiple lists. It only lets you have one. That’s crazy.

reviews.title: No undo
reviews.text: I’m deleting this app. I used it for several years, but today when I tried to delete one item, it turned out to be “delete all”. The problem is that the app doesn’t have “undo” or “restore”.

reviews.title: recovery
reviews.text: There is no way to recover any data that was deleted .

reviews.title: Delete by accident
reviews.text: There should be a way to save my list because if I accidentally delete it, I can’t get it back
